typography.strategy: Old Money Tech - Authority meets modern utility.

headings.styles: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter), leading-none.
headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 to create a high-impact, trustworthy, and authoritative feel.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and data tables to ensure maximum legibility.

labels.usage: Use for overlines above headings (e.g., 'WALLET NEGOCIOS').

primary.description: Midnight Blue / Obsidian (Base background, conveys deep trust and institutional weight).

secondary.description: Warm Gold / Sand (Accent color for primary CTAs and active states, conveys premium service).

surface_glass.description: Used for sticky header, floating navigation, and elevated cards.

surface_solid.description: Used for solid cards and section alternations.

text_primary.description: For maximum contrast on dark backgrounds.

rules: Avoid pure black (#000000). Always use tinted darks like Midnight Blue.
Always ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

visual enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke on glass surfaces (border-white/10).
visual enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows for raised elements (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]).
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark sections to create a premium velvet/matte feel.
visual enhancers.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle radial glows behind key UI components or hero text (e.g., bg-radial from-slate-800 to-transparent).

component name.Button: Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md), premium feel. Primary CTA uses the Gold accent with black text. Hover state translates Y (-translate-y-1) and increases brightness.
component name.Card: Cardless or subtle solid surfaces. For feature grids, use 1px border-white/10, bg-slate-900/40, backdrop-blur-md, with inner padding p-8.
component name.Navigation: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B132B]/80). Navigation links must be visible on desktop. Fixed to top (z-50).
component name.Icons: lucide-react. Use thin stroke widths (1.5) to match the premium 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic. No emojis.

grids.bento: Use Mode A 'Tetris' Grid for features (Wallet Negocios, Soluciones). Mix span-2 and span-1 sizes with gap-6 or gap-8.
grids.data_density: Use Mode B for dashboard preview graphics in the hero section.

layouts.hero: Split layout or centered authoritative text. 'Plain-money headline copy'. Hero image should be a product UI preview or dashboard interface. Strong trust badges near the CTA.
layouts.sections: Generous spacing (py-24 to py-32). Alternate between pure dark base (#0B132B) and elevated surface (#141E3C) to define sections.
layouts.bento_features: For 'Restaurantes y bares' and 'Casinos', use overlapping elements and asymmetrical bento grids.
layouts.blog_grid: 3-column grid for articles with edge-to-edge images and bold typography for titles.

motion.interactions: Hover states must exist on all interactive elements. Buttons lift slightly. Links show subtle underline or color shift.
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling using 'lenis'. Staggered fade-up (translate-y-4, opacity-0 to opacity-100) for grid items.
motion.micro: Subtle scale-up on image hover in blog cards.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA for text. Dark theme requires high luminance text.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] focus:outline-none on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='cta-hero-button').

media.images: Use high-quality imagery of modern business, luxury casinos, and restaurant payments. Darken images using bg-black/40 overlays if placing text directly over them.

3d libraries.usage: If needed for abstract tech background, use TSParticles for subtle floating constellations, or Framer Motion for 3D card spins. Keep it extremely performant.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium dark-themed marketing landing page for 'Enlace Fintech'.
Content sections to build: Header (Nav), Hero (Value prop + UI preview), Restaurantes y bares, Wallet Negocios (AQPay, SPEI, Terminales), Persona física/crédito, Casinos, Blog, Footer.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Manrope for body text. Install these via Google Fonts.
Implement a deep Midnight Blue (#0B132B) background with Warm Gold (#D4AF37) accents. NO purple AI slop.
In the Hero section, use plain-money language and place the 'Fintech Dashboard Interface' image (or a clean UI mockup) as the focal point alongside the main copy.
For the 'Wallet Negocios' section, build a Bento grid layout detailing features like SPEI, AQPay, and point-of-sale terminals.
Create a clean, text-based logo in the header using Cabinet Grotesk (e.g., ENLACE in bold, FINTECH in light) accompanied by the abstract geometric gold shape image as the logo mark.
Ensure all sections have generous spacing (py-24 or py-32).
Integrate lucide-react for all iconography. Do NOT use emojis.
Implement a contact form using standard HTML/Tailwind styling with Shadcn logic if necessary, styled to match the dark luxury theme.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds over content that scrolls behind it. Always use a blur and opacity.
Avoid standard Bootstrap-style 12-column layouts; embrace asymmetry and negative space.
